items.title: 3 Stocks Riding The Shift Away From Search Ads
items.summary: Alphabet’s wobble in search has cracked open a rare window where investors are suddenly forced to rethink where digital ad dollars might flow next. When a long trusted profit engine comes under question, money often goes looking for fresh stories, new business models, and different kinds of pricing power. This article walks through 3 stocks exposed to that shift, explaining how each could either benefit from or be hurt by the current reset in expectations. The three stocks below are a small...

items.title: Google Plans to Spend $17 Billion on Wyoming Data Center
items.summary: Alphabet Inc.’s Google will spend $17 billion to build a data center in Wyoming, formally putting a price tag on the proposal two days after voters across the US delivered a broad rebuke to the development of such massive projects for artificial intelligence work.

items.title: Full Show
items.summary: Host and "The Buy Side" author Turney Duff and his panel of experts weigh in on investment strategy post-midterms, the IPOs of OpenAI and Anthropic, and the impact of the blue wave in Congress on the AI ecosystem. Today's panel includes Hennion & Walsh CIO Kevin Mahn, Neostellar Principal Willy Lee, Grenadilla Advisory Founder and CEO Anna Rathbun, and Futurum Chief Market Strategist Shay Boloor.
